screen: Production Create (phone 390, full page), stage 4 pass 2

expected_differences: Demo Coffee Co. and its D initial correctly replace the Lab’s fictional business identity.
The message and notification badges show production counts of 2 and 7; these are real application states, not visual drift.

This Create selector has no configured payment amount, selected creator or campaign status yet. Payment-basis labels are appropriate; the Lab Home’s fictional identities and vehicle asking prices should not appear here.
keep: Mineral canvas, ink typography, restrained dividers and shadow-free working regions.
The 16px phone gutters, strong page title, clear section headings and readable body and payment-basis text.
Three vertically stacked source-to-decision assemblies with aligned decision columns and staggered starts—not generic boxed campaign cards.
Portrait samples at 9:16 and the landscape car photograph, with placement shown separately on a diagram rather than painted onto the vehicle.
Cobalt setup actions with explicit campaign-type labels; all three routes remain visible.
Literal payment bases: per approved video, per approved Story, and per car per month.
Business switching, search, messages, notifications and all five navigation destinations, with Create visibly selected.
review.readiness_note: Sign off the Create selector at 390px. The capture exposes all three setup routes and the business navigation without clipping. It does not verify downstream publishing-credit checks, creator fees, approval payments or installation payments; those require their own screen and interaction reviews.
review.why: The supplied Lab is desktop Business Home, not a Create specification, so fidelity is appropriately judged against the approved language rather than its records or rail layout. Production preserves the mineral surface, Archivo-led heading hierarchy, operational text scale, open source-ratio media and restrained cobalt decisions. The portrait sources occupy narrower widths than the car while the decision edge stays aligned; the source-column joint and lowered decision starts retain the phone offset logic. The car remains an unmodified photograph with a separate placement diagram. Payment bases are legible beneath each explanation and make no escrow, reserved-funds or business-side fee claim. Headings and setup links wrap without collisions or horizontal clipping. The phone navigation is complete, and its document-end position is the stated capture accommodation. No concrete release-blocking design drift or visible loss of functionality is evident.
review.verdict: Yes—the 390px Create selector faithfully adapts Frame Shift into three clear, source-led setup choices while preserving the visible business functionality.
